entities.name: Antun Mihanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antun Mihanović was a Croatian poet and lyricist, most famous for writing the national anthem of Croatia, which was put to music by Josip Runjanin and adopted in 1891. Klanjec, his birthplace, holds a monument to him and a gallery of his works.
